title: Zesty Saudi Arabian Romano Pepper Bake
description: A winey, fluffy, meal-prep Saudi Arabian dish featuring Romano peppers, this bake is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the flavors of Saudi Arabian cuisine with the convenience of a raw-friendly meal prep option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tops off the Romano peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, onion, tomato paste, white wine, salt, and black pepper.
Stuff each pepper with the oil and spice mixture, filling to the top.
Place the peppers in a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and top each pepper with feta cheese.
Return the peppers to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the peppers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
